defs.def: to take part in or become involved in an activity 参加；参与

ex.s: Join us for TransForm, the interactive summer camp that helps you teens find your passion by participating in various activities and connecting with others.
ex.t: 加入我们的TransForm吧，这是一个互动夏令营，通过参与各种活动并与他人建立联系，帮助青少年找到自己的热情。

ex.s: Besides, your parents will also be able to participate in workshops selected just for them to learn about cutting-edge science.
ex.t: 此外，你的父母也能参加专为家长挑选的研讨会，了解前沿科学。

ex.s: According to the schedule, which activity can the teens participate in?
ex.t: 根据日程安排，青少年可以参加哪项活动？

ex.s: Those who are dressed inappropriately will be refused permission to participate.
ex.t: 着装不当者将被拒绝参加。

ex.s: Signing up for the programme does not automatically mean that you will be able to register and participate.
ex.t: 报名该项目并不自动意味着你将能够注册并参与。

ex.s: development testsB. participate in pair meetings
ex.t: 发展测试 B. 参加双人见面会

ex.s: He always participated to the best of his ability in whatever they were doing.
ex.t: 无论他们在做什么，他总是尽自己最大的能力参与。

ex.s: Freedom Day is held every year on 27 April to celebrate South Africa’s first fully-participated elections in 1994, in which everyone was allowed to vote regardless of skin colour.
ex.t: 每年4月27日是自由日，庆祝南非1994年首次全民参与的选举，在这次选举中，无论肤色如何，每个人都被允许投票。

ex.s: Have you ever participated in any of them?
ex.t: 你参加过其中任何一个吗？

ex.s: How well did you actively participate and contribute ideas?

ex.s: So, I am here on Macquarie Island to participate in the programme to tackle this very problem.
ex.t: 所以，我在这里的麦克夸里岛 参与这个计划 来解决这个问题。
